Build information

Source: R/info.R
zumime_info.Rd

Reports what this build of zumime contains: the package version and the version of the generated type tables, which is the date of the upstream sources they were built from.

Usage

zumime_info()

Value

A list with version, the package version as a string; table_version, the date of the table sources as a string ("YYYY-MM-DD"); and family, the optional family packages this session can offer text to with mime_type(text = "family").

See also

mime_type() for the arguments that use the family.

Examples

zumime_info()
#> $version
#> [1] "0.1.0"
#> 
#> $table_version
#> [1] "2026-10-19"
#> 
#> $family
#> [1] "zucsv"  "zujson"
#>
